name: IFL Enterprises Ltd
about: IFL Enterprises Ltd deals in the agri commodity business, including import and export of agricultural produce like fruits, vegetables, seeds, organic and herbal products, trading of agri commodity products, including contract farming and warehousing. The company also deals in trading financial instruments like shares, stocks, and bonds.[1]
keyPoints:
No Promoter Holding[1]
Mr. Nishant Subhash Chandra Gandhi, the last classified promoter, sought reclassification as a public shareholder during FY25. This was implemented and approved, **so the company now officially has no promoter or promoter group holding. All shares are publicly held. **

pros: Stock is trading at 0.52 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 61.8% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.73% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.50 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 288 days.
